Requirements You are about to cast a spell that targets only yourself.

You use your catalyst to preview one of your spellcrafts using a helpful ally to observe its effects. When you cast your catalyzed spell, you can target an ally within 30 feet of you. They gain the effects of the spell instead of you. If the spell has a duration, they gain its effects at half its listed duration (minimum 1 round). If the spell’s effects are contingent on a round-by-round basis, this action fails. If it has a sustained duration, you must Sustain the spell.

Visionary Catalyst Your potent catalyst ensures the effect remains as long as it can. If the spell has a duration, the effects last the full duration rather than half.
